decision.interpretation: This is a text-field discovery screen, not a verified checklist. Review candidate records individually for actual waterbody identity, source dataset, rights, taxonomy, dates, locality, and quality before preparing any assertion. Unreturned records, zeroes, candidate name variants, and missing salinity do not establish absence or complete coverage.
